stay.id: Nggak. Dinda lagi denger. Dan Bima belum selesai.
stay.en: No. Dinda is listening. And Bima isn't done.

text.id: Lo lagi. Mau nanya soal Senin malem lagi?
text.en: You again. Here to ask about Monday night again?

text.id: Raka. Gue udah nebak lo bakal nelpon.
text.en: Raka. I figured you'd call.

text.id: Senin, jam sembilan. Lo yang jemput dia.
text.en: Monday, nine o'clock. You picked her up.

text.id: ...Siapa yang bilang?
text.en: ...Who told you that?

text.id: CCTV TPI. Mobil perak, hatchback. Dan lo nanya ke dia "udah sampe?".
text.en: The fish auction CCTV. A silver hatchback. And you asked her "did you get there?".

text.id: Oke. Iya. Gue yang jemput.
text.en: Okay. Yes. I picked her up.

text.id: Dia minta dianter ke Angke. Katanya mau ketemu narsum. Gue nggak boleh ikut turun. Dia nyuruh gue pulang, dan gue pulang.
text.en: She asked me to drive her to Angke. Said she was meeting a source. I wasn't allowed to get out with her. She told me to go home, and I went.

text.id: Pesannya gue hapus karena kantor gue bilang jangan ikut campur urusan Sekar. Kalau ketahuan gue nganter dia, gue bisa dipecat.
text.en: I deleted the message because my office told me to stay out of Sekar's business. If they found out I drove her, I could be fired.

text.id: Jam sebelas gue nanya dia udah sampe belum. Maksudnya, udah ketemu orangnya belum. Dia nggak pernah bales.
text.en: At eleven I asked if she'd gotten there. I meant, had she met the guy yet. She never answered.

text.id: Lo ngasih nomor HP Sekar ke Aditya. Bentang Pesisir.
text.en: You gave Sekar's number to Aditya. Bentang Pesisir.

text.id: Pak Didit? Dia klien kantor gue. Dia bilang mau bantu nyari. Dia punya pengacara, Ka. Gue kira...
text.en: Pak Didit? He's my office's client. He said he wanted to help look for her. He has lawyers, Ka. I thought...

text.id: Dinda duduk di kasur Sekar, tangannya ngepal di pangkuan.
text.en: Dinda sits on Sekar's bed, her hands fists in her lap.

text.id: "Lo bohong ke polisi, Bim. Ke semua orang."
text.en: "You lied to the police, Bim. To everyone."

text.id: "Hari ini gue lapor ke Ipda Yusuf."
text.en: "I'm telling Inspector Yusuf today."

text.id: (Biarin dia ngomong.)
text.en: (Let him talk.)

text.id: Gue tahu! Lo pikir gue nggak tahu? Gue nggak tidur dari Senin!
text.en: I know! You think I don't know? I haven't slept since Monday!

text.id: Bima memutus panggilan
text.en: Bima hung up

text.id: Jangan. Ka, please. Kasih gue satu hari. Satu hari aja, gue yang ngomong sendiri ke polisi.
text.en: Don't. Ka, please. Give me one day. Just one day, and I'll tell the police myself.

text.id: Panggilan berakhir
text.en: Call ended

text.id: Gue sayang dia, Ka. Gue cuma pengen dia aman. Makanya gue... pernah ngomong sesuatu ke bos gue. Soal Sekar.
text.en: I love her, Ka. I just wanted her safe. That's why I... once said something to my boss. About Sekar.

text.id: Bukan apa-apa. Lupain. Gue harus pergi.
text.en: It's nothing. Forget it. I have to go.

text.id: Panggilan berakhir
text.en: Call ended
